Native FMOD 2.02.13 group-volume captures: 48 kHz stereo float32, 512 frames. Generated by tools/native_volume_probe.cpp with 16-frame DSP buffers and constant stereo 1 input. Captured after group fader, before master. Default automatic volume ramp enabled.

Targets: 0.25 at frame 0; 0.75 at frame 16 (events), or the same 0.25 again (repeat); -0.5 at 128; mute at 256; unmute at 384. Truncate probe capture to first 4096 bytes. Ramp starts at previous current gain and takes 64 samples. Identical targets do not restart it. Tests compare every sample exactly through the kernel and an already-playing mixer group, explicitly accounting for the existing downstream master node's one-sample delay. Full engine startup latency and channel-level volume smoothing remain separate issues.

channel-events/channel-repeat are independently captured with the same schedule applied to a Channel instead of a ChannelGroup. Run native_volume_probe OUTPUT channel or channel-repeat. Their gain traces match the corresponding group traces byte-for-byte. The channel mixer test includes SFX and master downstream groups and aligns their existing two-sample delay.
